mapper.sql: CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid(n.link_param_desc,'jsonb') THEN n.link_param_desc::jsonb ELSE '{}'::jsonb END

n.user_id=#{userId} AND (n.link_scrn_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( WITH RECURSIVE active_menu AS (SELECT menu_id,scrn_id FROM sys.menu WHERE upr_menu_id IS NULL AND use_yn='Y' UNION ALL SELECT m.menu_id,m.scrn_id FROM sys.menu m JOIN active_menu p ON p.menu_id=m.upr_menu_id WHERE m.use_yn='Y') SELECT 1 FROM sys.user_role ur JOIN sys.role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id AND r.use_yn='Y' JOIN sys.role_menu_auth a ON a.role_id=r.role_id AND a.inq_auth_yn='Y' JOIN active_menu m ON m.menu_id=a.menu_id AND m.scrn_id=n.link_scrn_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND (m.scrn_id NOT IN ('UI-23','UI-24','UI-25') OR r.admin_yn='Y') AND (r.data_scope_cd='ALL' OR (r.data_scope_cd='PART' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.user_part p JOIN mst.bsn_part b ON b.bsn_part_id=p.bsn_part_id AND b.use_yn='Y' WHERE p.user_id=#{userId} AND p.bsn_part_id::text=()->>'partId')) OR (r.data_scope_cd='PROJECT' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.user_prj p JOIN prj.prj b ON b.prj_id=p.prj_id AND b.use_yn='Y' WHERE p.user_id=#{userId} AND p.prj_id::text=()->>'projectId')) OR (r.data_scope_cd='SELF' AND ()->>'userId'=CAST(#{userId} AS text))) ))
